review_method: Read complete original/candidate patch and checker as text, read non-binding protocol in full, hash all bound files. No scientific/component execution or compilation.

candidate_assessment.coefficient_cache: Original scalar floating-point expression trees retained: a=u/s; phi(a)=exp(-a*a/2)/sqrt(2*pi); ndtr(-a); normalization=(s*sqrt(2*pi))*flux. Immutable production reservoir parameters are explicitly scoped. External attribute mutation equivalence is not claimed.
candidate_assessment.cdf_guard: count0 returns before residual variables. A break occurs before v changes; its residual norm is reusable against unchanged 2e-12 final guard. The for-else exhaustion branch recomputes CDF after the sixth v=proposed. Both 1e-14/2e-12 tests, six-update cap and physical bracket rejection remain.
candidate_assessment.stream_concatenation: No RNG calls or ledger/crossing arithmetic moved. Retained particles and left/right arrivals remain in keep,left,right order. Each positions/incoming array is newly allocated, appended to a list and subsequently only referenced; rebinding in the next side does not mutate previous arrays. Final concatenate allocates fresh output, preserving input nonmutation and particle order.
candidate_assessment.protected_scope: No matching_order/collision_round/macro_arrival_count/majorant/cap/finiteness/conservation modifications. No threshold, timestep, seed, sampling/histogram cadence or failed-state retention edits.

checker_assessment.derivation: 10 protected functions +58 baseline original files +57 unchanged candidate files +2 CDF/grid cases +16 sample count/seed cases +2 extreme inverse cases +4 forced guards +14 stream cases =163.
checker_assessment.exactness: same() requires exact dtype/shape/C-order bytes for ndarrays and exact NumPy scalar bytes. RNG method/arguments/output hashes/final state compared; not just a distribution or moment comparison.
checker_assessment.negative_controls: Pure artificial discontinuous CDF forces all six updates and seventh residual check; constant CDF forces physical-bracket exception. Both require expected error and same trace. Cross-domain stream case requires its expected exception/payload equality. No stateful mock or tolerance relaxation.
checker_assessment.boundary_coverage: Two reservoir drifts, count0/1/4/32, extreme quantiles including zero, near-zero quadrature branch, production-sized state, empty state, one-sided arrivals, both exits/arrivals, x==length, zero-arrival exits, and cross-domain rejection are specified.
checker_assessment.timing: One old-only cProfile workload and exactly three fixed legacy/candidate reset-state component repetitions are proposed. No simulate/main or coupled physical trajectory. Outer30s enforcement is explicitly parent-owned; checker itself is not an outer-timeout implementation. No speedup or full-main success inference.
